subject: [RFC PATCH v3 08/14] mm/memcontrol: Make memory.low and memory.min tier-aware

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch extends the existing memory.low and memory.min protection to be tier-aware, allowing for proportional best-effort and guaranteed memory protection of higher-tier memory in systems with multiple workloads isolated via the memory cgroup controller. This addresses a limitation where only total memory footprint was enforceable, not where that memory resides. The patch makes no changes unless tiered memcg limits are enabled. It modifies the include/linux/memcontrol.h and mm/memcontrol.c files to implement this new functionality.
